<script setup lang="ts">
// <Bar3DChart>: a bar per region × quarter cell, colored by height
// (`colorBy: "z"`); the axes name the categories.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Bar3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    sales: "Sales (k€)",
    regions: ["North", "South", "East", "West"],
    quarters: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
  },
  zh: {
    sales: "销售额（千欧元）",
    regions: ["华北", "华南", "华东", "华西"],
    quarters: ["第一季度", "第二季度", "第三季度", "第四季度"],
  },
  ja: {
    sales: "売上（千ユーロ）",
    regions: ["北部", "南部", "東部", "西部"],
    quarters: ["第 1 四半期", "第 2 四半期", "第 3 四半期", "第 4 四半期"],
  },
  fr: {
    sales: "Ventes (k€)",
    regions: ["Nord", "Sud", "Est", "Ouest"],
    quarters: ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"],
  },
};

// sales per region (rows) and quarter (columns), k€
const SALES = [
  [120, 135, 150, 180],
  [90, 110, 105, 130],
  [160, 170, 190, 220],
  [70, 85, 95, 100],
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() => [
  {
    name: text.value.sales,
    colorBy: "z" as const,
    data: SALES.flatMap((row, i) =>
      row.map((z, j) => ({
        x: text.value.regions[i],
        y: text.value.quarters[j],
        z,
      })),
    ),
  },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <Bar3DChart
    :series="series"
    :x-axis="{ categories: text.regions }"
    :y-axis="{ categories: text.quarters }"
    :z-axis="{ title: text.sales }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// Two series on the same cells are stacked: sales in stores and online per
// product and year; `bar-width` thins the bars, the legend toggles a channel.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Bar3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    channels: ["Stores", "Online"],
    years: ["2023", "2024", "2025"],
    products: ["Shoes", "Bags", "Watches"],
  },
  zh: {
    channels: ["门店", "线上"],
    years: ["2023", "2024", "2025"],
    products: ["鞋子", "包袋", "手表"],
  },
  ja: {
    channels: ["店舗", "オンライン"],
    years: ["2023", "2024", "2025"],
    products: ["靴", "バッグ", "時計"],
  },
  fr: {
    channels: ["Magasins", "En ligne"],
    years: ["2023", "2024", "2025"],
    products: ["Chaussures", "Sacs", "Montres"],
  },
};

// per channel: products (rows) × years (columns), k units
const CHANNELS = [
  [
    [40, 38, 35],
    [22, 24, 20],
    [15, 14, 12],
  ],
  [
    [18, 27, 36],
    [9, 14, 21],
    [6, 9, 13],
  ],
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() =>
  text.value.channels.map((name, c) => ({
    name,
    data: CHANNELS[c].flatMap((row, i) =>
      row.map((z, j) => ({ x: i, y: j, z })),
    ),
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <Bar3DChart
    :series="series"
    :bar-width="0.55"
    :x-axis="{ categories: text.products }"
    :y-axis="{ categories: text.years }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: 3D bar chart
translationResources.description: Bars over an x × y category grid: lit boxes, per-series colors, stacking across series, colors from a color scale by height or by another value, legend and color bar.

sales.title: Sales by region and month
sales.description: Monthly sales of five regions: category axes with names from the locale and month names from Intl.DateTimeFormat, amounts in compact currency.

stacked.title: Stacked with legend
stacked.description: Three product lines stacked in each quarter × market cell; the legend at the bottom toggles a series and the stacks shrink accordingly.

pyramid.title: Population pyramid
pyramid.description: Women above 0 and men below (negative heights), by age group and census year: a population pyramid repeated over time.

traffic.title: Color by height
traffic.description: Website visits per hour of the week: colorBy "z" colors the 168 bars by their height with the plasma ramp and a color bar.

margin.title: Color by another value
margin.description: Revenue sets the height and the margin the color (the value of each datum with colorBy "value"): the tallest bars are not the most profitable ones.

inventory-live.title: Live warehouse stock
inventory-live.description: Units left in the bins of a warehouse, aisle × shelf level, updated every second by a seeded setInterval cleaned up on unmount. Bins below 20% of their capacity move to a second series with the danger color, so a cell has its bar in exactly one series (z: null in the other), and empty bins are restocked.

cohort-retention.title: Cohort retention
cohort-retention.description: The share of each monthly signup cohort still active n months later; recent cohorts have fewer months of history, left empty with z: null. Cohort names come from Intl.DateTimeFormat, the bars are colored by height (colorBy: "z"), and a click reads the retention and the active users of the cell.

budget-variance.title: Budget variance
budget-variance.description: Quarterly spend of six departments for the selected fiscal year: the bar height is the actual spend and the color the variance to budget. colorBy: "value" with the diverging coolwarm scale and a symmetric valueRange keeps on-budget cells neutral, overspending warm and underspending cool.

datacenter.title: Server room heat map
datacenter.description: Racks of a server room with the power draw as height and the inlet temperature as color on the inferno scale. The switch remounts the chart in a dark ConfigProvider, the button calls setCamera() on the ref for an orthographic floor plan (onCameraChange keeps it in sync), and the summary lists the racks above the recommended inlet temperature.

Bar3DChartProps.series: Bars over the x × y category grid; bars of several series in the same cell are stacked
Bar3DChartProps.barWidth: Width of the bars of the series that do not set one, as a fraction of a cell

Bar3DSeries.data: The bars: objects or [x, y, z] tuples (x and y are category names or indices)
Bar3DSeries.barWidth: Width of the bars as a fraction of a cell, 0-1

Bar3DDatum.x: X category (a name or its index)
Bar3DDatum.y: Y category (a name or its index)
Bar3DDatum.z: Height; null leaves the cell empty, negative heights go down from 0
Bar3DDatum.color: Bar color; wins over the series color and the color scale
Bar3DDatum.value: Value mapped to the color scale (colorBy "value")
Bar3DDatum.label: Text shown in the tooltip

Chart3DCommonProps.height: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.xAxis: X axis (width of the box): title, range, ticks, format, categories
Chart3DCommonProps.camera: Initial camera (azimuth, elevation, zoom, projection, field of view), also restored by a double click; changing it moves the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.autoRotate: Turns the camera around the box: true at 12°/s or a speed in degrees per second; pauses while hovered, off-screen and with reduced motion
Chart3DCommonProps.aspect: Proportions of the box (x, y, z)
Chart3DCommonProps.box: Draws the axis box: back walls, grid lines, tick labels and axis titles
Chart3DCommonProps.colorScale: Colors of colorBy "z" / "value": a built-in ramp (viridis, plasma, inferno, magma, cividis, turbo, spectral, coolwarm, terrain, blues) or CSS colors
Chart3DCommonProps.valueRange: Values mapped to the ends of the color scale; the data range by default
Chart3DCommonProps.colorBar: Color bar of the color scale (title, format); shown when a visible series uses the scale
Chart3DCommonProps.legend: Legend; shown when several series have a name, clicking an item toggles its series
Chart3DCommonProps.tooltip: Tooltip; false disables it, render replaces its content
Chart3DCommonProps.interaction: Drag rotates, right / Shift + drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, double click resets, arrow keys rotate; false makes the chart static
Chart3DCommonProps.lighting: Ambient, diffuse and specular light of the surfaces and bars
Chart3DCommonProps.exposure: Brightness of the light of additive series (blend "additive"), tone mapped on WebGPU and WebGL2: dense glowing regions saturate gracefully instead of turning white
Chart3DCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the data layer: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software
Chart3DCommonProps.palette: Series colors (defaults to the --chart-series-1..8 CSS variables, then the theme colors)
Chart3DCommonProps.locale: Language of the built-in texts (accessible summary, legend announcements, tooltip row names) and of the number formatting; built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (<html lang>), then the browser language
Chart3DCommonProps.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts of the locale (see Chart3DLabels)
Chart3DCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered point, cell or bar changes
Chart3DCommonProps.onPointClick: Called when a point, cell or bar is clicked
Chart3DCommonProps.onCameraChange: Called after the user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it is ready (and after a fallback)
Chart3DCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: resetCamera, getCamera, setCamera, getRenderer, getInstance

Chart3DSeriesBase.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip
Chart3DSeriesBase.color: Series color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); the palette when omitted
Chart3DSeriesBase.hidden: Hides the series (it stays in the legend)
Chart3DSeriesBase.format: Formats the value (or the height) of the hovered item in the tooltip

Chart3DLegendOptions.toggle: Clicking an item toggles its series

Chart3DTooltipOptions.render: Renders the tooltip content (a string is set as text); null hides it

sales.title: Sales by region and quarter
sales.description: A bar per region × quarter cell, colored by height; the axes name the categories.

stacked.title: Stacked channels
stacked.description: Two series on the same cells are stacked (stores and online); thinner bars, legend toggles.

props.options: Other engine options (Chart3DOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered point, cell or bar changed; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point, cell or bar was clicked; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }
events.minerva-camera-change: The user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera; detail: { azimuth, elevation, zoom, pan, projection }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.resetCamera: Restores the camera of the options
methods.getCamera: Current camera, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
